bibliography.title: Exact Functional ANOVA Decomposition for Categorical Inputs Models

abstract_sentences.text: Functional ANOVA offers a principled framework for interpretability by decomposing a model’s prediction into main effects and higher-order interactions.
For independent features, this decomposition is well-defined, strongly linked with SHAP values, and serves as a cornerstone of additive explainability.
However, the lack of an explicit closed-form expression for general dependent distributions has forced practitioners to rely on costly sampling-based approximations.
We completely resolve this limitation for categorical inputs.
By bridging functional analysis with the extension of discrete Fourier analysis, we derive a closed-form decomposition without any assumption.
Our formulation is computationally very efficient.
It seamlessly recovers the classical independent case and extends to arbitrary dependence structures, including distributions with non-rectangular support.
Furthermore, leveraging the intrinsic link between SHAP and ANOVA under independence, our framework yields a natural generalization of SHAP values for the general categorical setting.
We provide a basic Python implementation of our method.

final_judgment.single_storyline: 对 categorical support 定义 inverse-likelihood Fourier family，使其满足 hierarchical orthogonality；再以 Gram system 与低阶优先的 rank-selected basis 将 generalized ANOVA 变为可计算的 SHAP-style attribution（pp.3--6）。
final_judgment.main_body_keeps: 主文保留定义、Theorem 3.2、uniqueness 条件、Algorithm 1、复杂度、独立 SHAP 对照、高维 rank trade-off 和两个限制，因此读者在数据前能识别每项实验所对应的理论边界。
final_judgment.appendix_moves: Appendix A 放完整证明，Appendix B 放硬件、模型和部分参数，Appendix C 放 TreeHFD 对照；formal proof、实现审计和该 baseline 条件都依赖附录。supplementary code 未在输入中提供。
final_judgment.best_pattern: 用最近邻方案的假设失败建立需求，再让一个 basis definition 同时驱动 orthogonality、independent recovery、sparse rank selection 和实验指标。Tables 6--7 用同一 rank 参数连接解释容量、误差和运行时。
final_judgment.largest_gap: Sparse support 下最有意义的 S_r 尚无原则性选择，greedy rank search 是高维瓶颈；实验又缺 seed、重复与不确定性信息，数值稳定性无法从本文量化。
final_judgment.transfer_rule: 理论型解释论文应让每个实验对应一个形式化承诺：构造先定义对象，定理给出可检验性质，实验分别测试独立、依赖、稀疏和计算边界。
final_judgment.transfer_boundary: 该规则适用于具有清晰 mathematical object、可写出假设和可观测后果的研究。用户偏好、开放式生成或缺少 ground truth 的部署效果需要额外识别设计，不能仅以 reconstruction 或内部 consistency 作结论。
